item.title: Candace Owens raises new questions about Charlie Kirk after revealing a never before seen image with no visible blood
item.description: Candace Owens shared claims about a photo she says shows Charlie Kirk after an alleged shooting. She questioned the official story and named people she said could not be trusted. However, there is no verified evidence, police record, or official confirmation that Charlie Kirk was shot or killed. Her statements remain unproven and widely disputed.

item.title: Beast Games Season 2 brings back 10 fan-favorite Season 1 players
item.description: Season 2 of Beast Games has launched on Amazon Prime Video, featuring a $5 million prize and a mix of new and returning contestants. Ten fan-favorite players from Season 1 have rejoined the competition, including the previous winner Jeff Randall Allen and runner-up Twana Barnett, promising heightened drama and strategy.

item.title: ‘Green Arabia’: Saudi Arabia’s vast deserts were once rivers, lakes and grasslands, studies show
item.description: New scientific studies show Saudi Arabia’s deserts were once humid, green landscapes shaped by rivers, lakes and monsoon rains. Evidence from archaeology, satellite mapping, lake sediments and cave stalagmites reveals repeated human settlement during wet phases of the Quaternary. The findings underpin modern Saudi efforts to combat desertification, revive ‘Green Arabia’, and restore degraded land at unprecedented scale nationwide today.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Eli Crane moves to honor YouTuber Nick Shirley with Congressional Gold Medal after viral Minnesota daycare fraud claims
item.description: Rep. Eli Crane announced a bill to award Nick Shirley the Congressional Gold Medal after Shirley’s viral video on alleged Minnesota daycare fraud. Crane praised Shirley’s work, while officials and daycare managers offered pushback. The FBI confirmed an active investigation. The issue continues to spark strong public debate and online reaction.

item.title: Twitch streamer Brudivoeller_TV surprises fans with rotten apple strudel in WoW dungeon
item.description: German streamer Brudivoeller_TV surprised viewers during a World of Warcraft session. He showcased a moldy apple strudel, joking about its potential to cause a disaster. Fellow streamers urged him to discard the food item. This incident, alongside his previous food neglect stories, has captured online attention. His quirky personality and unexpected moments continue to entertain his growing audience.

item.title: 'We will take all the oil': US reveals plan for Venezuela; what are the 3 phases?
item.description: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio outlined a three-phase plan for Venezuela post-Maduro, asserting that Washington is planning "to execute a deal to take all the oil" that is stuck in the country with proceeds benefiting the Venezuelan people. Rubio also confirmed upcoming meetings with Danish officials regarding the US interest in acquiring Greenland.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Mehdi Hasan calls for Elon Musk's 'prosecution'; Tesla boss fires back
item.description: Tech mogul Elon Musk's political involvement, particularly his role in the Trump administration, has drawn sharp criticism. Journalist Mehdi Hasan accused Musk of orchestrating the Somali fraud case, suggesting a future Democratic presidential candidate should run on a platform to prosecute him. Musk responded with a dismissive warning, highlighting the intense online political discourse.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: 'No state has right ...': Russia furious over US seizing oil tanker; cites maritime law
item.description: US forces seized a Russian-flagged oil tanker, the Marinera, in the North Atlantic, citing violations of US sanctions. Russia vehemently condemned the action, asserting it lacked legal basis and violated freedom of navigation on the high seas. The tanker, previously sanctioned and renamed, had reportedly evaded a US blockade near Venezuela.

item.title: Explained: Will Trump's play for Greenland break NATO?
item.description: Secretary of State Marco Rubio announced a meeting with Denmark next week amid concerns over a potential US annexation of Greenland. Danish Prime Minister Mette Frederiksen warned such a move would end Nato, while Donald Trump's past skepticism and recent statements on alliance commitments add to the uncertainty.

item.title: ‘Healthy kids do better without vaccines’: Katie Miller echoes anti-vaccination claims — video
item.description: Stephen Miller's wife, Katie Miller, stated her youngest son is unvaccinated and healthy, while her oldest is vaccinated and had allergies. She believes healthy children fare better unvaccinated, a view shared by anti-vaccine activist Jenny McCarthy. This perspective contradicts scientific consensus on vaccine safety and efficacy.
